name: Business-Software.com

sources.title: Add Your Product — 'Submit your software solution for free... There is no cost involved'; they contact you within 2 business days

requirements: Product must be business software fitting one of their categories (Accounting, ERP, CRM, HR, BI, etc.)
Submission is explicitly free: 'There is no cost involved in submitting your product to our database'
Submitting grants Business-Software.com and affiliates rights to use your info, logo/trademark, and links in their marketing materials (opt out in writing)
CAPTCHA on the form — manual submission likely required
preparation: Company name, product name, contact name, email, phone, job title
A short message describing the product
Marketing assets for distribution: white papers, brochures, videos (they offer content distribution)
Logo/trademark you are comfortable having republished on their site and affiliates
workflow: Fill the contact-style form (name, email, company, product name, phone, job title, message) and solve the CAPTCHA
Submit — they state they will contact you within 2 business days to complete the submission
Respond to their outreach to finalize the listing
watchFor: Not self-serve: the form is an inquiry; a human completes the listing after their outreach
Broad IP consent in the disclaimer — they may reuse your marketing copy and logo on affiliated sites
Phone number is optional but listed; expect a sales-adjacent follow-up
No account creation needed for the initial form
countsAsLive: The product has a public page under business-software.com/product/<slug>/ (e.g. /product/striven/) and appears in 'Recently Added Products' / category browse
unknowns: What the completed listing includes (they mention editor reviews and user community reviews exist)
Whether listings can be declined and on what grounds
Link attribute (dofollow vs nofollow) on published product pages
